verdict.rationale: Stable states it scans the internal contents of mail, not just the envelope, at high resolution and for free, and offers 'scan mail' as a core action. Keyword routing on text inside the mail and AI summaries of contents imply the scans are OCR'd and machine-readable. However, the evidence never mentions searchable-PDF output or any stated turnaround time, which is half of what this story asks for. Missing for 10: a stated same- or next-business-day scan turnaround, explicit searchable-PDF/OCR output format, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
